summary: The migration adds amount_scaled, copies amount_minor into it, and drops amount_minor in the same transaction. The expand and the contract happen in one deploy.

facts.statement: The migration adds amount_scaled and populates it from amount_minor.
facts.evidence_ref: cases/C05/candidate.sql: ADD COLUMN amount_scaled and the UPDATE

facts.statement: The migration drops amount_minor in the same transaction.
facts.evidence_ref: cases/C05/candidate.sql: ALTER TABLE payments DROP COLUMN amount_minor

facts.statement: The case declares a v1 application that reads and writes amount_minor.

assumptions.statement: Every application instance writing amount_minor has been replaced before this migration runs.

invariants.description: Both application versions preserve declared semantics during rollout.
invariants.executable_check: Run each live version's declared statements against the migrated schema.
